title: Messaging — Wake Request — payload
description: A sender that has just queued mail for a DID asks that DID's mediator to ring the device, naming the queued messages by the identifiers the mediator stores them under. Contentless: no task type, reason or content. The mediator answers every request with the same empty response, whatever it did.

addressee.description: The DID the queued messages are addressed to — an account at the mediator receiving this request.

msgIds.description: The messages the requester queued for the addressee, by the identifier the addressee's mediator stores each under (as messaging/message/status and messaging/message/list name them). Holding one is evidence of having held the stored message.

urgency.description: OPTIONAL. Passed to the gateway as push/wake's urgency hint. `interactive`: a person is expected to act now. `background`: the device may collect at its convenience. Absent: the mediator sends no urgency.

ext.description: Ecosystem-defined extension members per SPEC.md §4.5.1. A mediator ignores every ext member when deciding whether to ring.

Response.title: Messaging — Wake Request — response payload
Response.description: Always exactly {}: the same answer whether the mediator rang, armed the request, coalesced it, or did nothing, so that the response cannot tell a sender whether the addressee exists, is wakeable, is online or was rung. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/wake/request/0.1#response.
